Messages.Author: Sascha Neumayr
Messages.Body:
Can I play Darkling Trickery in response to my opponent's Rötschreck ro
prevent my Kiasyd from going into Torpor?

Since both cards are played when a Vampire "attempts to strike", Darkling
Trickery should kick in. The opposing vampire no longer does aggrevated
damage and my Kiasyd should be safe.

Or did I misinterpret something?

Best regards,
Sascha Neumayr

Messages.Author: salem
Messages.Body:
On Sun, 27 Jul 2003 00:28:55 +0200, "Sascha Neumayr"
<sascha....@gmx.net> scrawled:

>Can I play Darkling Trickery in response to my opponent's Rötschreck ro
>prevent my Kiasyd from going into Torpor?

No.

>Since both cards are played when a Vampire "attempts to strike", Darkling
>Trickery should kick in. The opposing vampire no longer does aggrevated
>damage and my Kiasyd should be safe.

If yu play DT before they play Rotschrek, you'll be safe.

>Or did I misinterpret something?

Acting minion gets first chance to play cards. If they declare strike:
ivory bow (and they are not acting and you are) you get a chance to
play DT before they get a chance to play Rotschrek.

if you decline to play DT and then they play Rotschrek, combat is over
and you are in torpor so you can't play DT _in response_ to Rot. The
only things playable in response to Rot are Sudden Reversally stuff
and combat continuers/restarters (TT, Psyche!).

salem
